user.title: AdGuard Rule Control
user.description: Connect to AdGuard Home. Examples: 192.168.1.10, 192.168.1.10:3000, adguard.example.com, or adguard.local:3000/control.

reconfigure.title: Update AdGuard Connection
reconfigure.description: Change the AdGuard Home address, credentials, or SSL settings. The connection is tested before anything is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign In to AdGuard Again
reauth_confirm.description: AdGuard rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current AdGuard Home username and password.

error.invalid_response: AdGuard Home returned an unexpected response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid AdGuard Home URL.

abort.already_configured: This AdGuard Home instance is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The AdGuard connection was updated successfully.

init.title: Rule controls
init.description: Create rule controls, combine them into family profiles, or configure optional privacy-conscious activity totals. Every control is available to native Home Assistant dashboards and automations.

blocked_services.title: Add Blocked Services Control
blocked_services.description: Choose AdGuard's built-in blocked services, such as YouTube, TikTok, Discord, or gaming services. This creates one Home Assistant switch that toggles those services through AdGuard's blocked-services API.

data_description.display_name: This becomes the friendly name of the switch.
data_description.blocked_service_ids: Select one or more built-in AdGuard services.
data_description.blocked_service_target: Choose everyone or one persistent client from AdGuard Home.
data_description.quick_block_minutes: The dashboard buttons will temporarily block or allow for this many minutes, then restore the previous state.
data_description.icon: Optional Home Assistant icon, such as mdi:youtube or mdi:block-helper.

blocked_service_preset.title: Choose a Service Group
blocked_service_preset.description: Start with a useful group or choose individual services. Only services supported by your AdGuard Home installation are saved.

preset.title: Choose a rule preset
preset.description: Pick a preset to pre-fill the name, icon, and rule list. You can edit the rules before saving. Choose custom rules if you want to type your own domains.

website.title: Block a Website
website.description: Type a website name or paste its address. Examples: youtube.com, roblox.com, or reddit.com. The integration will create the AdGuard rule for you.

audience.title: Who Should This Apply To?
audience.description: Choose one device/client for bedtime, school, or focus controls. Choose everyone only when you really want this rule to affect your whole AdGuard Home network.

client.title: Choose a Device or Client
client.description: Pick a client discovered from AdGuard Home, or choose manual entry if the device is not listed yet.

manual_target.title: Enter Client Manually
manual_target.description: Use an IPv4 address, IPv6 address, MAC address, or exact AdGuard client name. Examples: 192.168.1.25, aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff, Living Room TV.

review.title: Review and Save
review.description:
This will create or update {entity_id}. When the switch is turned on, AdGuard Rule Control will manage {rule_count} item(s):

{preview}

select_profile.title: Choose a Profile
select_profile.description: Profiles combine existing controls into one switch, such as Bedtime, Homework, Dinner, or School Night.

profile.title: Control Profile
profile.description: Choose the controls that should turn on and off together. The profile becomes one Home Assistant switch and uses one synchronized AdGuard update.

data_description.display_name: Examples include Bedtime, Homework, Dinner, or School Night.
data_description.profile_control_ids: Select one or more existing rule controls.
data_description.icon: Optional Home Assistant icon, such as mdi:weather-night or mdi:school.

activity.title: Privacy and Activity
activity.description: Optional activity totals read only recent blocked query-log entries. Domains and raw rows are never retained. Client names and blocked-service totals may appear as sensor attributes when enabled.

data_description.activity_enabled: Leave this off for the most private and lightweight setup.
data_description.activity_limit: Higher values improve the last-24-hours estimate on busy networks but require a larger AdGuard response.

control.title: Rule control
control.description: Each saved control creates one switch entity. Rules are one per line. Example block rule: ||youtube.com^. Example allow rule: @@||allowed.example.com^. Use target type global for everyone, or choose IPv4, IPv6, MAC address, or AdGuard client name to limit the switch to one client.

data_description.display_name: This becomes the friendly name of the switch.
data_description.entity_enabled: Leave this on if you want Home Assistant to create an automation-friendly switch entity.
data_description.rules: Enter one AdGuard rule per line. Presets fill this in for you.
data_description.target_type: Global applies to everyone. Client-specific targets add AdGuard's client modifier automatically.
data_description.target_name: Optional friendly name shown in comments inside the managed rule block.
data_description.target_value: For client-specific controls, enter an IP address, MAC address, or AdGuard client name.
data_description.quick_block_minutes: The dashboard buttons will temporarily block or allow for this many minutes, then restore the previous state.
data_description.icon: Optional Home Assistant icon, such as mdi:youtube or mdi:web-off.

confirm_block_all.title: Confirm Block All Internet
confirm_block_all.description: This rule targets everyone and can stop DNS access for every device using this AdGuard Home instance. Confirm only if that is intentional.

data.confirm_block_all: I understand this can block internet access for the whole network

error.invalid_rule: Rule or client target is invalid.
error.invalid_domain: Enter a valid website domain, such as youtube.com.
error.invalid_profile: Choose a profile name and at least one rule control.
error.unsupported_service_group: None of the services in that group are available from this AdGuard Home installation.
error.block_all_not_confirmed: Confirmation is required before saving a network-wide Block All rule.

managed_state_unavailable.title: AdGuard rule state needs attention
managed_state_unavailable.description: AdGuard Rule Control could not safely read or update its managed state: {error}. Check the AdGuard connection, update AdGuard Home if its blocked-services API is unavailable, then use the Sync button.
